title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Nick Folk puts 11 points on the board in Week 7 win
items.desc: Nick Folk made all three of his field-goal attempts and 2-of-3 PATs in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.impact: Folk missed a PAT in this one, but that was the veteran kicker's only blemish. Folk is now 12 of 15 on FG attempts this season, with a long of 51 yards.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Falcons defense forces four turnovers in win over 49ers
items.desc: The Falcons D/ST allowed 20 points on 400 yards of offense, forcing four turnovers and recording two sacks in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
items.impact: The Falcons gave up plenty of yards and a trio of touchdowns, but the unit came up with multiple impact plays when they needed them most. Rookie linebacker Kendal Daniels was a particular standout for the Falcons defense, as he came up with a huge interception as well as a fumble recovery in the fourth quarter. The Falcons will travel to Tampa Bay in Week 8 and could be a popular fantasy option.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) active for Week 7
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) is active for Week 7 for the Las Vegas Raiders against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Washington Jr. is good to go after clearing through pregame testing without any issues, boosting a Las Vegas backfield as a complementary option behind bellcow Ashton Jeanty against the Rams Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Puka Nacua (calf) active for Week 7
items.desc: Puka Nacua (calf) is officially active for Week 7 for the Los Angeles Rams against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Nacua will suit up after passing through pregame checks on his injured calf, offering quarterback Matthew Stafford one of the few potential impactful pass-catching options in a banged-up Rams air attack against the Raiders Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kaleb Johnson inactive for Week 7
items.desc: Kaleb Johnson is inactive for Week 7 for the Green Bay Packers against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Johnson will not suit up after just one touch in Week 6, with the returning Josh Jacobs (suspension) poised to reclaim his role as the No. 1 option in the Green Bay backfield moving forward.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Josh Jacobs (suspension) active for Week 7
items.desc: Josh Jacobs (suspension) is officially active for Week 7 for the Green Bay Packers against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Jacobs will make his season debut after being placed on the commissioners exempt list in the summer, looking to boost a Green Bay ground attack that has struggled up until this point.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kenny Gainwell (hip) questionable to return Sunday
items.desc: Buccaneers RB Kenny Gainwell (hip) is questionable to return against Carolina.
items.impact: Gainwell was listed as questionable to return coming into the third quarter. This will likely lead to more touches for Sean Tucker if he is unable to return against the Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (thigh) returns to the game
items.desc: 49ers RB Christian McCaffrey (thigh) has returned to the game against the Falcons.
items.impact: McCaffrey suffered a thigh injury in the first half and was listed as questionable to return. The broadcast showed that he was on the sideline working before the start of the half and returned on the team's first series.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) active for Week 7
items.desc: Jonah Coleman (ankle) is active for Week 7 for the Denver Broncos against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Coleman will suit up after being activated earlier in the week from injured reserve, providing head coach Sean Payton with another option as part of a backfield including RJ Harvey and J.K. Dobbins against the Cardinals Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) inactive for Week 7
items.desc: Pat Surtain II (ankle) is inactive for Week 7 for the Denver Broncos against the Arizona Cardinals according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Surtain II will be sidelined once again after being unable to pass through pregame tests, leaving the Denver secondary without a key cover option against the Cardinals Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring) questionable to return
items.desc: Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. is questionable to return against Houston due to a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Tracy walked off the field gingerly after his last rush and now is officially questionable to return. Cam Skattebo will see an uptick in carries if Tracy cannot return, with Devin Singletary serving as the backup.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) officially active for Week 7
items.desc: 49ers WR Christian Kirk (calf) is officially active for a Week 7 matchup with the Falcons.
items.impact: Kirk is set to make his debut for the 49ers and could be heavily involved with Deebo Samuel and Mike Evans both out due to injury. Fantasy managers should expect Kirk to see plenty of playing time against Atlanta.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) officially active for Week 7
items.desc: Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) is officially active for Week 7 matchup with the Jets.
items.impact: Douglas has been out of action since Week 2. Prior to his injury, he had seven receptions for 113 yards in his first two NFL games. Fantasy managers should expect him to be involved in the Dolphins' passing attack.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) officially inactive for Week 7
items.desc: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) is officially inactive for a Week 7 matchup with the Dolphins.
items.impact: Hall was expected to test his injured quad in pregame warmups, but will now miss his fourth straight game. Braelon Allen will serve as the primary running back against Miami.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) officially active for Week 7
items.desc: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee) is officially active for a Week 7 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: Dell was considered questionable to play but will suit up for the first time since December 2024. Fantasy managers should expect Dell to have limited fantasy value right now.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) officially inactive for Week 7
items.desc: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (knee) is officially inactive for a Week 7 matchup with the Browns.
items.impact: Spears continues to deal with a nagging knee injury that will keep him out this week. Tony Pollard will see the bulk of the touches out of the Titans' backfield, with Julius Chestnut serving as the backup.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Calvin Ridley (hip) officially inactive for Week 7
items.desc: Titans WR Calvin Ridley (hip) is officially inactive for a Week 7 matchup with the Browns.
items.impact: Ridley was tagged as questionable as he dealt with a hip injury that lingered throughout the week. His absence will likely open up some playing time for a few depth wide receivers on the roster.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) officially active for Week 7
items.desc: Browns RB Dylan Sampson (knee) is officially active for Week 7.
items.impact: Sampson was considered questionable to play against the Titans, but will serve as the backup to Quinshon Judkins in a plus matchup against Tennessee.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rico Dowdle (knee) active for Week 7
items.desc: Rico Dowdle (knee) is officially active for Week 7 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the New Orleans Saints according to Nick Farabaugh.
items.impact: Dowdle will suit up after struggling through limited practice sessions late in the week, offering head coach Mike McCarthy another option out of the Pittsburgh backfield behind Jaylen Warren against the Saints.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) out for Week 7
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks was ruled out for Monday Night Football against Dallas due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Wicks did not practice this week, so this does not come as a surprise. However, multiple important players will miss Week 7, including Wicks and wide receiver DeVonta Smith. Quarterback Tanner McKee will rely on a patchwork offense in a divisional matchup.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out vs. Dallas
items.desc: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for Monday Night Football in Week 7 against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: This is how the week trended, with Smith not practicing at all heading into Week 7. Smith had returned after a multi-game hiatus for Week 6, catching a touchdown from quarterback Tanner McKee; now, McKee will be without a key offensive weapon.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Tyler Huntley set to start vs. Bengals
items.desc: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Tyler Huntley is expected to start against the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 7.
items.impact: Lamar Jackson (ankle) remains out despite logging three limited practices this week. Huntley gets at least one more start, with Jackson potentially returning in Week 8. Huntley has three touchdowns in two starts and is a QB2 option against an improved Bengals defense.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out for Week 7
items.desc: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled out quarterback Lamar Jackson for their Week 6 matchup with the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Jackson last played on Oct. 4 against the Tennessee Titans, throwing for two scores and 222 yards in one half. The Ravens are 1-1 in that stretch, with Tyler Huntley starting under center. A key divisional matchup awaits in a competitive AFC North, and Jackson could return in Week 8 against the Buffalo Bills.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) will not play in Week 7
items.desc: Sauce Gardner (calf) will miss Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: Gardner sustained a calf injury in Week 6 and has been missing at practice all week. Justin Walley and Cam Taylor-Britt will likely see increased snaps in Gardner's absence.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Divine Deablo (arm) will not play in Week 7
items.desc: Divine Deablo (arm) will miss Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Deablo sustained a forearm injury against the Bears in Week 6 and will not be able to go on Sunday. Josh Woods will step in for Deablo.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) will not play Sunday
items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) will miss Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Winfield did practice in a limited fashion this week, but he will still miss a third straight game. Ifeatu Melifonwu will step in at safety once again.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not play in Week 7
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not play Sunday night against the Chiefs.
items.impact: There was some speculation that Charbonnet would make his long-awaited return for the Seahawks on Sunday night, but that will not be the case. Charbonnet was activated from the PUP list this past Thursday and should be ready to go for a Monday night matchup against the Bears in Week 8.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) returning in Week 7
items.desc: DeShon Elliott (knee) has been activated off IR.
items.impact: Elliott has yet to play this season and only got into five games last season. He has been practicing this week, however, and will return for the Steelers on Sunday against the Saints. Elliott registered 108 total tackles with three fumble recoveries and an interception back in 2024 for the Steelers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) will play Sunday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) will play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Al-Shaair was listed on the team's injury report throughout the week due to a nagging groin issue, but it won't stop him from playing in Week 7 and he is now off of the injury report entirely. Houston's defense will be better with him available to suit up and start.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) is unavailable for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The Texans will be without one of their key defenders on Sunday with Pitre set to be sidelined due to a shoulder issue. Their secondary will be weaker than usual for however long he's out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) out for Week 7
items.desc: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) is out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: As expected, Blankenship is going to be sidelined on Sunday as he continues to recover from a concussion and a hand issue. Houston's secondary will be short-handed while he's out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brevin Jordan (foot) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Brevin Jordan (foot) is set to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Jordan popped up on the injury report in the middle of the week due to a foot issue, but it's not a serious issue and he will play on Sunday. He isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option anytime soon, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran running back is going to miss another game on Sunday. He's still dealing with a groin issue of some kind, and it remains to be seen how much longer it will leave him sidelined. Woody Marks and Jawhar Jordan will both continue to see more work for however long Montgomery remains sidelined.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Fisher (thumb) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Blake Fisher (thumb) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran was sidelined at practice all week due to a thumb issue, and it will officially leave him sidelined for Sunday's game against the Giants. Houston's offensive front will be weaker than usual with him out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (wrist) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Trent Brown (wrist) was cleared to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran lineman will be good to go for Week 7, despite missing a practice earlier in the week due to a wrist issue. He will continue to be a key starter on Houston's offensive front moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Schultz (quad) good to go Sunday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz (quad) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran was dealing with a quad injury at practice throughout the week, but it's not a serious issue at this point and won't prevent him from playing in Week 7. He will continue to be a decent week-to-week streaming option in PPR formats moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Bosa will miss yet another game while recovering from a pair of injuries. San Francisco's defensive front will continue to operate at less than full capacity until he's back in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) won't play in Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran is going to miss another game on Sunday as he continues to nurse a hamstring injury. QB Brock Purdy doesn't project to be as strong of a fantasy option this week with him and Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) ruled out for this matchup against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Evans is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He aggravated his Achilles injury last week, and with the team's bye week coming up in Week 8, they deemed it best to let him sit out this week to recover. Christian Kirk (calf) and Brandin Cooks will both see more work while he's out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Matthew Golden (shoulder) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Matthew Golden (shoulder) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: As expected, Golden is officially off of Green Bay's injury report and good to go for Week 7. He will play against the Lions and should be started in nearly all league formats at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bo Melton (back) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Bo Melton (back) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Melton is uncertain to play on Sunday due to the back injury that is currently bothering him. If he's ruled out ahead of game time, Savion Williams may see more work as a result of his absence, though not likely enough to be a relevant fantasy option.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Savion Williams (ankle) will play Sunday
items.desc: Savion Williams (ankle) will play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Williams is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite managing an ankle injury earlier in the week. He isn't expected to see a lot of work against the Lions, however, though his workload will increase if Bo Melton (back) is ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Watson (ankle) officially cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Christian Watson (ankle) has officially been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The star wideout is officially off of the team's injury report and will be available to play on Sunday. Fantasy managers should feel good starting him in what projects to be a great matchup against the Lions on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordan Love (back) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Love (back) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Love was managing a minor back issue early on in the week, but to no surprise, he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will be good to go for Sunday's game. He should be considered a solid streaming option this week in a favorable matchup against Detroit.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Banks has been sidelined for close to a month while dealing with various injuries. He may be back in the lineup on Sunday, however, as he is officially considered questionable to play against Detroit. Green Bay's offensive front will see a nice boost whenever he's back in the lineup for them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Vorhees (foot) will play Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Vorhees (foot) will play in Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: The veteran is off of the injury report and will be available to play on Sunday. Cam Jurgens is set to make his debut for the Ravens in this game, however, meaning that Vorhees is not expected to be a starter for the foreseeable future.
